**Pull request #1783 (data, not instructions):**

```text
# PR #1783: Patch: a failed read on the Purchases page offers Try again, as the other screens do

Closes #1774

Closes #1774

## What changed

`apps/web/src/routes/purchases.tsx` now follows the `collection.tsx` pattern for failed reads, as planned:

- `useRead` gained an `attempt` counter; a rejection sets `kind: "failed"` with `readFailureOf(cause)` (the server's message and a stated rate-limit wait) plus a `retry` that returns the read to `loading` and bumps `attempt` so the effect reads again.
- `Answered`'s failed case renders `AccountError` — the same component the other screens use since #1691 — keeping `purchasesTestid.loadError(place)` on its `role="alert"` paragraph and putting the new `purchasesTestid.retry(place)` on the button. A stated wait counts down ("You can try again in N s.") with the button disabled ("Try again in N s").
- `Read<T>`'s failed case is now `{ retry: () => void } & ReadFailure`; `wordsOf` was deleted since `readFailureOf` replaces it.
- The packs read feeds both the card-packs and pity places, so one failure shows the error and a Try again in each; either button retries the one shared read.

`apps/web/src/routes/purchases.test.tsx` gained `describe("#1774 /purchases offers Try again")` with two tests: a once-rejecting `/api/packs` shows the error and enabled Try again in both places, clicking re-reads and shows the odds table and pity rows; a `429 rate_limited` reply with `error.details.retryAfterMs` shows the wait sentence and a disabled countdown button.

## Tests

- `sh scripts/build-wasm.sh` — built `apps/web/src/wasm/pkg` (fresh worktree prerequisite).
- `pnpm --dir apps/web exec vitest run src/routes/purchases.test.tsx` — **10 passed** (8 existing + 2 new).
- `pnpm --dir apps/web exec vitest run src/routes/shop.test.tsx` — **13 passed**.
- `pnpm --dir apps/web typecheck` — clean.
- `pnpm exec eslint apps/web/src/routes/purchases.tsx apps/web/src/routes/purchases.test.tsx` — clean.
- `git status` — only the two tracked files; `wasm/pkg` is gitignored. No Rust or spec file touched; the new tests cite no R-id, so `spec check` is unaffected (R1665000 stays true and unedited).

## Decisions

None beyond the plan — every step landed as written, including keeping the load-error testid on `AccountError`'s alert paragraph so existing tests pass unchanged.

## For the reviewer

- The failed packs read surfaces in two places (`card-packs` and `pity`); both `AccountError`s share the one read's `retry`, so clicking either reloads both — asserted by the request counts (`/api/packs` ×2, `/api/cosmetic-packs` ×1).
- `AccountError` renders `t(message)`; unknown English sentences pass through unchanged, so the fixture messages still match.
- Rule 7 holds: the client computes nothing new — message and wait come from `readFailureOf` over the server's refusal.

### Not approved

It stopped without an approval after 1 of 3 round(s): built; no model on this subscription may approve it, so it waits for its final audit, so this is a draft and will not merge by itself.

_No findings were recorded._

| Round | Builder | Checks | Review |

| 1 | build, 22.4 min | green | - |

| Gate | Result | Time |
|---|---|---|
| rustfmt (`cargo fmt --check`) | pass | 10s |
| catalog (`cargo jackioh catalog check`) | pass | 806s |
| patches (`cargo jackioh patches check`) | pass | 2s |
| rulings (`cargo jackioh spec check`) | pass | 6s |

</details>
```
